substantiveCommits.message: Add physically feathered facade weathering shader
Add facade weathering optical QA and pre-render guard
Enforce optical weathering on every benchmark save
Bind optical weathering to formal 4K evidence path
Lock weathering residue physical material scalars
Use Standard BRDF and reflection probes for weathering residue
Declare weathering UV carrier sampler explicitly

criticalDefectRisksAddressed: visible primitive-placeholder geometry in benchmark framing

discovery.rejectedInitialHypothesis: The legacy WeatheringOverlays Cube strips were initially suspected to survive into the benchmark. Source inspection showed QualityBlockFacadeWeatheringDetailUpgrade already destroys that legacy root and rebuilds five combined non-primitive meshes, while its structural QA rejects built-in primitive weathering meshes.
discovery.actualHighValueDefect: The replacement geometry still used Standard transparent materials with a single uniform alpha per material. Its UVs were present and normalized, but optical density did not feather at ribbon/strip/ellipse boundaries. At native 4K this could read as a hard decal/paint stripe even though the geometry itself was source-anchored.
discovery.evidenceInvariantGap: QualityBlockNative4KReviewPacket did not explicitly rebuild/revalidate the final facade-weathering optical state before ReflectionProbe, still Camera.Render and sealed temporal evidence. The save gate only guaranteed the older structural weathering state.

shader.name: NewTown/QualityBlockWeatheringResidue
shader.model: Unity Standard surface BRDF with alpha-fade masking, live direct/shadow/GI/reflection-probe response, hard-coded dielectric metallic output 0, high roughness and zero emission.

profiles.verticalRibbon: UV0 cross-edge feather plus short source and long causal tail fade
profiles.gradeStrip: strongest optical density at grade with upward fade while geometry retains the irregular splash-height boundary
profiles.horizontalEllipse: radial fade around AC condensate discharge residue

shader.microVariation: Low-amplitude world-space deposit-density modulation only. It does not encode sun direction, AO, contact shadow or highlight.

implementation.persistence: QualityBlockFacadeWeatheringSaveGate now rebuilds causal weathering, applies optical refinement and validates both during every benchmark save once DanchiHighDetail exists.
implementation.formalEvidenceBinding: QualityBlockNative4KReviewPacket validates contract configuration up front, applies the optical refinement after final facade/rail/AC/rainwater/futon host construction, then revalidates before ReflectionProbe, before native still Camera.Render and again before sealed temporal capture. MainCamera onPreCull also fail-closes if the final optical state drifts.

selfAuditCorrections.issue: The first shader implementation used a custom ForwardBase GGX path. Although it had live sun/shadow response, it omitted environment/reflection-probe specular, weakening grazing-angle dielectric plausibility.
selfAuditCorrections.correction: Replaced the manual forward fragment lighting with Unity's Standard surface BRDF so the thin residue shares direct light, shadows, GI and reflection-probe environment response with the host facade. Metallic remains forced to zero and roughness remains 0.90-0.95.

selfAuditCorrections.issue: The first physical-material version did not expose explicit locked material scalar slots for metallic, normal scale and wetness even though the contract defined them.
selfAuditCorrections.correction: Added _Metallic, _NormalScale and _Wetness shader properties with zero defaults; Standard surface output still hard-codes metallic=0 and no invented normal relief/emission.

selfAuditCorrections.issue: The surface shader relied on UV0 naming convention without an explicit sampler declaration for the no-scale-offset mask carrier.
selfAuditCorrections.correction: Declared sampler2D _MaskTex explicitly so uv_MaskTex has an unambiguous source in Unity surface-shader generation.

sourceFacts: Parent weathering already removes legacy WeatheringOverlays and rejects built-in primitive meshes.
Parent weathering mesh UV0 semantics cover 0..1 for vertical ribbons, facade grade strips and horizontal ellipses, enabling analytic opacity feathering without new texture masks.
Formal weathering evidence is already required from hero/facade_center, oblique/balcony_services and grazing/material_grazing by the visual observability contract.

New optical QA requires exactly five weathering MeshRenderers, exact material identities, the dedicated shader, normalized UV0 for every vertex, configured opacity/roughness/F0/profile values, transparent queue, shadow casting Off, receiveShadows true and no collider.

expectedVisualScoreImpact: Weathering/context causality: likely deduction risk reduced because residue extent remains construction-source-driven while optical boundaries now fade as deposited material instead of ending at a uniform-alpha polygon edge. No points awarded without pixels.

Material/PBR: likely deduction risk reduced because dry residue is explicitly dielectric/nonmetallic, high roughness, zero-emission and receives live Standard lighting plus reflection probes rather than carrying a baked highlight. No points awarded without pixels.

Texture/microdetail: likely hard-edge/decal-read risk reduced through analytic UV feathering and low-frequency world-space density breakup. Native 100% crops must still prove that the breakup is neither visible as a procedural pattern nor temporally unstable.

Critical defects: source-side risk is lower for primitive-placeholder weathering, painted/baked highlights, impossible metallic response and missing weathering material metadata, but none of these defects is cleared from the Visual Fidelity Gate until actual sealed render evidence exists.
nextBlocker: Unity 6000.3.0f1 runtime/compile evidence. At the first real Runner, stop speculative expansion and run Prepare Complete Native 4K Review Packet. Fail immediately on shader compile/import error or optical QA failure. Then inspect hero/facade_center, oblique/balcony_services and grazing/material_grazing at 100% for hard alpha contours, transparent sorting/overlap bands, dark halos, disconnected runoff starts, overly uniform procedural residue, reflection-response mismatch and any view-dependent painted look. Inspect sealed temporal frames for edge shimmer. Fix actual pixel defects before assigning Weathering, Material/PBR or Texture points.
recordingNote: Implementation Readiness stays 93/100 because this run improves source implementation and evidence invariants but does not provide the missing Unity compile/runtime verification. Visual Fidelity remains UNSCORED and 0 render-derived points were awarded.
